overlap.title: Exclude zero initialization at one or two owned MOVEs
overlap.body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The comparator is independently reproduced #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

Replace one or two original paid owned MOVEs with CLEAR in the source chart and fresh zero INIT in the destination. Preserve all other events and signed coefficients. Every original moved row is nonzero, and each of the 47 unit defects has a nonzero final public response. The original COPY guard stays clean for all 11 preceding defects.

All 1,081 distinct pairs are excluded. Exact 2×2 minors reject 1,073 pairs with independent moved rows. In each of the eight other pairs, a specific final public coordinate distinguishes the two suffix supports. The pair identity includes transport of the earlier perturbation into the later owned slot. These necessary conditions rule out cancellation without solving that transport coefficient. Both scopes are exhausted.

The optimistic best pair deletes 17 rank-six and 17 rank-five paid positions, with productive count 22,461 fixed. Its gross upper is 185.838303398540 raw, and the complete fixed-moonshot margin upper is 45.956805594899 raw. Both are rounded upward and grant ancillary work free. Realized saving is zero.

## Task and overlap

#7307 tests immediate CLEAR and a zero input on an older word. #7387 reconstructs the original owned row from a live donor bank on this exact word. This result uses zero initialization and tests final guarded observations, including simultaneous pairs. Canonical main was `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` at pre-submit refresh.

## Validation

Use CPython 3.12 with assertions enabled from a clean checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-owned-zero-rebirth-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay authenticates the exact word, regenerates nine receipts, and rejects two altered inputs. The research commit adds one package on the two existing #7257 CI fixes for the historical replay gap documented in #7371. The selected record is unchanged.

## Credit

#7387 supplies the original moved-row evidence, #7334 and #7113 the word and caller, #7338 the admission, #7362/#7298 the price stock and tariff, #7355/#7384 the row and span engines, #7307/#7308 earlier owned transport tests, #5557 the guard precedent, and #7378 a distinct owned aggregate. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Larger subsets, compensated edits and changed later events need separate exact support and pricing. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.

# Fixed-clock owned zero-rebirth observability

At each exact owned MOVE let Pᵢ be the moved row as a linear form on
the original public inputs. Let Sᵢ be the response to a unit defect
in that owned slot just after the original MOVE. Its observations
are the final public rows and the pre-write destinations of every
later COPY. Earlier guard coordinates in Sᵢ are zero by convention.
The exact normalized MOVE is the identity on its role value.
INIT and CLEAR reset a slot to zero. ADD, COPY and SCALE act with
the original signed rational coefficients. Evaluate COPY as a
linear assignment after recording its pre-write guard. This
relaxation is defined even when a candidate violates the guard.
A legal candidate must preserve both the observations and the
guard preconditions.

Replacing one MOVE by a CLEAR and zero INIT at the original clock
injects defect −Pᵢ in that slot. The full observation difference is
−SᵢPᵢ. Exact reverse covectors verify a nonzero coordinate of every
Pᵢ. A grouped forward sweep and separate per-site exact sweeps find
a nonzero final public coefficient of every Sᵢ. The independent
engine also pulls each first coefficient back from the final
public output. They agree on the first coefficient and number of
nonzero observations at each site. The sole original COPY is at
clock 33805. All 11 unit defects injected before that clock are
zero at its destination just before the write. No unvisited site
or single-site survivor remains.

## Two fixed-clock replacements

Let i < j and let g be the scalar response of the first unit
defect in the second owned slot just after the original MOVE j.
At that point the second slot would hold Pⱼ − gPᵢ after applying
the first edit alone. The second zeroing adds −Pⱼ + gPᵢ in its
slot. The resulting observation difference is

```text
−Sᵢ Pᵢ − Sⱼ Pⱼ + g Sⱼ Pᵢ.
```

If Pᵢ and Pⱼ are linearly independent, choose an input on which
Pᵢ vanishes and Pⱼ does not. The difference is nonzero because
Sⱼ is nonzero. If Sᵢ and Sⱼ are linearly independent, a linear
functional that vanishes on Sⱼ and is nonzero on Sᵢ leaves a
nonzero multiple of Pᵢ. Thus cancellation requires both pairs to
be proportional for any g.

Exact 2×2 prefix minors exclude 1,073 of 1,081 pairs. Each of the
other eight has a public observation that is zero in exactly
one full suffix column, proving suffix independence. The lead
screen's suffix support counts or first coordinates differ on
these same eight. The independent checks list exact differing
coordinates and coefficients. All pairs close before any
cross-transport or candidate computation.

This proof grants the normalized replacement even if the two
same-clock lifecycle changes would carry additional costs. A
successful normalized test would still require signed arbitrary-input
and adjoint equality, ownership, restoration, all-width physical and
compiler validity, and charged precision and tape checks.

## Directed price

A rank-r deletion saves 17 paid rank-r positions across the
signed caller. A single edit changes the paid count from 110,519
to 110,502. A pair changes it to 110,485. Productive count stays
22,461 and the rank surplus increases by 17 times the sum of
deleted ranks. No additional paid call is granted in the quote.

The strongest pair in the literal rank stock has ranks 6 and 5.
Its directed gross upper at the old crossing is 185.838303398540
raw and its complete margin upper at the fixed moonshot target is
45.956805594899 raw, both rounded upward. The predecode
all-site relaxation bounds gross credit by 1,896.702946936210 raw
at the old crossing and grants all 47 anchors independently.
The exclusions above certify zero realized saving in the tested
single and pair families. The all-site quote is a relaxation;
the pair theorem gives no conclusion for larger simultaneous sets.

overlap.title: Bound one next-contact donor MOVE hoist on #7334
overlap.body:
**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On #7334 aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace and #7113 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d, keep one donor's paid MOVE and hoist it to the same literal chart before the owned ascent. The donor must already be live and its old MOVE must be its next contact.

The geometry exhausts 23 paid ascents. Eight sites admit 13 eligible pairs. Two exact modular probes exclude all 13 single-donor multiples. Separate rational forward and reverse checks exclude all 13 spans of a shifted donor with the unchanged destination bank. Zero cases remain in scope. The eligible sites have a rigorous upper bound of 238 weighted-rank units with zero added paid calls. Verified paid savings are zero.

Run python3.12 -I -B research/p104-one-donor-move-hoist-bound/replay.py from a clean checkout. It authenticates the word and source receipts, regenerates seven receipts, and rejects an altered-input control. Registered and exported Git-free replay and all 27 onboarding tests passed locally. The branch includes two #7257 CI prerequisites.

#7334 and #7113 supply the word and caller, #7387 the fixed-bank result and exact separating inputs, #7355 the reverse engine, #7362 the rank stock, #7298 directed pricing, and #7360 comparator replay. #7330, #7378, #7392 and #7393 give related results. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

A multi-donor itinerary or changed observer remains open. Price one exact changed cut first, then test whether it defeats the committed separator.

# Geometry, normalized support and directed accounting

## Exact domain

Use the 76,466-event #7334 literal word, with 1,501 public roles and 68 owned fields. Normalize values in each chart using the source word's MOVE interpretation. MOVE changes the chart representation and preserves the normalized row. ADD, COPY and SCALE act on the normalized row with the exact stored rational coefficient. INIT and CLEAR reset the owned role. COPY requires a fresh zero owned destination.

Consider one paid owned ascent A→B at event t. A candidate donor is already live in its own current chart L, differs from the owner, and has as its first later operand contact an existing MOVE L→B. B must be the identical literal chart ID. L is arbitrary. Nearest contact includes both ADD and COPY operands and every unary operation, including lifetime events. This is the only MOVE allowed to commute before t. The donor is unchanged in normalized coordinates at t and it can supply a row at B. All eligible donors in the frozen word happen to be public roles.

The reverse census rewinds from the exact final charts to the exact initial charts and validates each literal chart and ownership transition. The proper GF(2) subspace relation distinguishes ascents from descents. The census also reconstructs all 47 old destination banks using the #7387 lead receipt and the extra live zero roles found by its independent check. The 23 ascents yield 15 empty eligible-donor sets and 13 eligible pairs at eight other sites. The old owner has immediate next contact in every case. The declared replacement contract requires its old normalized row at the fixed cut. An observationally equivalent suffix that permits a different intermediate owner row is outside this domain.

## Necessary support and exact exclusions

For a single signed copy, the new value must be plus or minus the donor row. Eight predecessor rational inputs give 13 counterexamples for each sign. On two other deterministic integer inputs, all 13 owner/donor pairs have nonzero 2×2 determinant modulo 65,521. The coefficient replay inverts every encountered denominator in that field. Reduction commutes with the rational word and cannot turn a zero determinant into a nonzero one. This additionally excludes any rational scalar multiple.

For the augmented family, the old owner row must lie in the rational span of the shifted donor and all old live roles in B other than the owner. The exact backward engine emits nine missing-coordinate exclusions and four exact rank exclusions. An independent full-source forward engine starts with one basis vector per public input, replays 45,648 literal events through the final tested cut, and reconstructs all exact owner and donor rows. It independently derives the old bank from liveness, checks the eight pinned old owner rows and verifies 13 exact covectors. Each covector gives zero on every augmented donor and a nonzero rational value on the owner.

These are counterexamples for the stated arbitrary-input interface. Two simultaneous donor moves, newly created donors, later owner reconstruction, changes to the fixed suffix, chart aliases and a redesign of the ownership contract remain open.

## Pricing before support

The preflight preserves the hoisted donor's paid call and provisionally removes one rank-r owned ascent across the 17 signed native invocations. It allows no extra paid children. The relaxed signed invoice therefore removes 17 paid rank-r positions while leaving productive targets fixed. The directed price records the exact complete residual at its pinned probe for each original rank, with rank surplus changing from 1,424 to 1,424 + 17r. Those positive residuals are conditional on actually deleting the operation.

The R176 upper ordinary allowance is 782,817,804 source units. It charges one replacement lifetime, six conservative route/map slots per native invocation, INIT/CLEAR and one signed copy. The R177 version permits up to 28 ADD/COPY coefficients, with 24-bit numerators, magnitude at most 65,534, denominator dividing 37,748,736,000 and the native smooth-alphabet requirement. Its provisional ordinary allowance is 782,979,372 source units, including six route/map slots at 1,000 each, four INIT/CLEAR units and at most 28 writes at 340 each for each of 17 invocations. Both are below the one-billion source-unit cap. This is a preliminary accounting bound, with physical route availability, chronology, restoration, canonical grid, precision, tape, compiler and full caller verification still required if support passes.

Eight distinct owner sites carry rank counts {1: 4, 2: 3, 4: 1}. Counting a deletion once per site even with several eligible donors, the eligible relaxation is at most 238 weighted-rank units for exponent s in (0, 1]. Compatibility and added costs can only reduce it. The broad 23-ascent relaxation in the directed price receipt is looser. Exact support eliminates every permitted one-hoist edit, so verified paid savings and Δκ are both zero.
